children: Technology One's reiterated fiscal 2030 target is seen as very achievable at Bell Potter. Analyst Chris Savage tells clients in a note that the Australian enterprise-software provider's A$1 billion annual recurring revenue target only requires average annual growth in the low-to-mid teens. Annual recurring revenue grew 18% in its 2026 fiscal year, which ended Sept. 30. Technology One's fiscal 2026 revenue fell just short of Savage's forecast, but he says this was offset by a better-than-expected profit margin. Bell Potter keeps a hold rating on the stock and raises its target price 5.1% to 36.00 Australian dollars. Shares are down 6.3% at A$32.95. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
